audit.why: Cassiopeia owns the lane from the first poison tick — Malphite stacks armour and health, both of which her magic-damage kit ignores. His only real swing is Unstoppable Force. Consistent with 55.2% over 221 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Unstoppable Force was called 'matchup-defining' and 'the whole green-light system' with no cooldown number anywhere.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s. At 130s in lane, its downtime is more than two minutes of free Cassiopeia — that is the actual spike, not a level.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and wants.you[1] now carry 130s and the 120s Petrifying Gaze number.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text asserted 'Unstoppable Force ignores your W ground, so don't rely on Miasma to stop it.' That is false and it directly contradicts the already-audited Malphite side of this matchup. Granite Shield was never mentioned despite being the reason his early trades feel survivable.
audit.why: Riot's Miasma text: grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities. Unstoppable Force is a dash (kit dash flag), so a Miasma cloud under Malphite stops the cast outright. Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% max health and only recharges if he has not been hit for a few seconds — continuous poison ticks mean it never comes back in lane.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text now says Miasma grounds Unstoppable Force; whys[1] adds the Granite Shield suppression; the mirror file audits/top/malphite__cassiopeia.json now agrees with this page.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file tags Malphite's Seismic Shard (Q) and Ground Slam (E) with a 'grounding' flag.
audit.why: Riot's own descriptions say Seismic Shard steals move speed and Ground Slam reduces attack speed — neither grounds. This is the tooltip-parser misfiring, and the already-audited Malphite side reached the same conclusion independently.
audit.corrected: No text claims Malphite grounds Cassiopeia; whys[3] names Ground Slam's attack-speed slow as dead weight against a mage instead.

edits.before: His one real swing is a flank R you never see — Unstoppable Force ignores your W ground, so don't rely on Miasma to stop it. Stay behind your front line and never face-check alone; you stack zero resistances.
edits.after: His one real swing is a flank R you never see. Miasma grounds Unstoppable Force — with the cloud under him he cannot launch it at all, so hold W for his angle, not the wave, and never face-check alone.

edits.before: Your Q into E combo comes online and Twin Fang's bonus damage ignores his armor entirely, with a cooldown refund on the poisoned target — start trading the moment his Q is down.
edits.after: Your Q into E combo comes online: poison ticks stop Granite Shield ever recharging, and Twin Fang refunds itself on a poisoned target — magic damage his armour stack does nothing about.

edits.before: Ranks in Q and E let you spam refunded Twin Fangs; his armor stack and W armor buff are dead weight against magic and he has no sustain.
edits.after: Ranks in Q and E let you spam refunded Twin Fang; his armour stack and Ground Slam's attack-speed slow are dead weight against a mage.

edits.before: Hold Petrifying Gaze and keep facing him to stun his R on arrival, not just slow him
edits.after: Hold Petrifying Gaze (120s) for Unstoppable Force — he arrives facing you, so it stuns

edits.before: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — Unstoppable engage — usually banked for teamfights, punish lane passivity. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Miasma for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — 130s at rank 1, and Miasma grounds it: inside the cloud he cannot launch at all. - Budget W Miasma (24s) for his angle and the 120s R for his arrival — never swap them.

edits.before: Unstoppable engage — usually banked for teamfights, punish lane passivity. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1 — banked for teamfights. Step up on its downtime, and ground it with Miasma when it is up.

edits.before: Track Malphite’s Unstoppable Force: Unstoppable engage — usually banked for teamfights, punish lane passivity. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Malphite’s Unstoppable Force: 130s at rank 1, and Miasma grounds it outright — a cloud under his feet is a hard no, not a slow. That is the green-light system.
